subject: Q3 settlement: invoice apportionment & PO split for Hummingbird Health
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@hummingbirdhealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@hummingbirdhealth.com, billing@hummingbirdhealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final Q3 charges / invoice split and PO questions

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was pleased with the latency improvements. We need to close the books for Q3 and have a couple of practical asks before we can schedule payment:

- Can you send a single final invoice that shows the contract true-up amount and splits the total across two POs (PO 12345 & PO 12346)? Our procurement system requires the PO reference on the PDF and separate line items per PO.
- We have a domestic withholding tax (WHT) requirement on vendor payments — do you have a WHT certificate we can store, or guidance if Redwood will gross-up?
- Last, please confirm the billing contact for remittance (wire vs ACH) and whether Redwood needs a remittance advice when we submit payment.

We have internal cutoff on Apr 20 to get the vendor invoice into our AP run. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Patel
Finance Manager, Hummingbird Health
Attachments: HB_PO_12345.pdf (PO), HB_PO_12346.pdf (PO)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@hummingbirdhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final Q3 charges / invoice split and PO questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the PO attachments.

I can get you a single PDF that includes: the true-up/renewal line items, a simple apportionment showing which amounts map to PO 12345 vs 12346, and a final total.

Quick answers:
- We can produce the invoice with PO references and separate line item allocations (we'll include the PO number on each page footer as well).
- Redwood typically issues invoices net of any withholding; if Hummingbird is required to withhold domestically we will accept the net payment but need a WHT certificate or official remitter statement so we can record the tax credit. If you prefer Redwood to gross-up, we'll need to run that through finance (that will change the invoice amount and may require an approval).
- Payment methods: wire is preferred for this customer tier; ACH is possible with additional verification. Remittance advice is helpful — please include invoice number and deal id when you submit.

I've attached a draft 'apportionment worksheet' (spreadsheet) and a draft invoice stub for review. Monica is on CC to confirm PO handling and collections cadence; Rafael is looping for any commercial exceptions.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm if Hummingbird will withhold taxes or provide a WHT cert (we can accept either).
2) We issue the final invoice PDF with both PO numbers referenced by EOD Apr 13.
3) Hummingbird confirms payment method and provides remittance timeline to hit your Apr 20 AP cutoff.

If any of that needs to change I can get finance involved.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0147
Attachments: Redwood_Q3_apportionment_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Final_Invoice_stub_Q3.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah@hummingbirdhealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final Q3 charges / invoice split and PO questions

Thanks, Avery and Sarah — quick clarifications from ops:

- We can do PO-level line items as requested. In practice we attach a short PDF appendix that maps line-item IDs to PO numbers; that's usually accepted by AP.
- For WHT: please send the certificate (scanned) to finance@redwoodinference.com. If you don't have a certificate, a copy of the remitter's payment instruction showing the withholding amount + tax code will work temporarily while we reconcile.
- For the remittance method: please indicate wire beneficiary details on the payment and include the Redwood invoice number in the wire reference. We send a short remittance confirmation email once funds are posted.

Sarah — to keep your Apr 20 cutoff, best for us to:
1) You confirm WHT approach by EOD Apr 13.
2) We send final invoice PDF with both PO refs Apr 13 (we'll aim for 10:00 PT).
3) Hummingbird schedules the wire for Apr 18 to ensure next-day posting and reconciliation.

If you prefer us to gross-up instead of accepting withheld net, flag that now and Rafael will follow up on pricing rework.

Monica Patel
Senior Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@hummingbirdhealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final Q3 charges / invoice split and PO questions

Morning all — confirming our approach so there are no surprises on renewal accounting: 

1) Redwood will accept the net payment if Hummingbird withholds tax, provided we receive an official WHT certificate or remitter proof. Please attach that to the wire or email to finance@redwoodinference.com.
2) If you instruct Redwood to be grossed-up, we will issue an adjusted invoice and require approval from procurement (this will delay the AP run).
3) We'll issue a single consolidated invoice PDF (Redwood_Final_Invoice_Q3_2028.pdf) that includes two invoice sections: one allocated to PO 12345, one to PO 12346, with subtotals and a final total. The invoice footer will include HB-2027-RNW-038 for reconciliation.
4) Expected timeline: final invoice sent Apr 13 10:00 PT; payment window Apr 18–19; confirmation and remittance advice requested from Hummingbird once wire is initiated.

If Sarah confirms WHT approach now I won't need procurement approvals. Otherwise, please let us know and we'll pause to rescope.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Final_Invoice_Q3_2028.pdf (final invoice), WHT_certificate_HB.pdf (placeholder, pending Sarah's upload)
